rule: External authority and provider substrate may be marked pending, but never fabricated or used as a cosmetic release blocker.

items.need: Lawfully sourced provider rosters with license/NPI/bar identifiers, provenance, ownership, refresh cadence, and correction process.
Real vertical reviewers with verified credentials, explicit approval, review scope, and sameAs profile.
Independent press, podcasts, .edu references, defensible Wikidata/Wikipedia, and genuine community citations.
Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster indexing, coverage, and click data.
Semrush, Profound/Otterly/Peec or reproducible manual AI-citation panel results.
